title: HAPPY INTERNATIONAL COFFEE DAY 2026
benefit: Free Coffee. Any Coffee. All Day.
description:
Internationl Coffee Day Alert
Free Coffee. Any Coffee. All Day.
Celebrate International Coffee Day with a complimentary coffee at Gourmet Carousel
Choose any coffee-based drink on our Barista menu, hot or iced. Flat white, long black, iced latte: take your pick.
No minimum spend. In-house guests and walk-ins are both welcome.
Register on the spot using the QR code at the counter.
Join us on 1 October, from 7.30am to 6pm.
Terms and Conditions
Valid on 1 October 2026 only, from 7.30am to 6.00pm, at Gourmet Carousel - Barista Experience. Registration is required to receive a single-use redemption screen. One complimentary coffee per person. Eligible for any coffee-based drink on the Barista menu, hot or iced. No purchase required. No cash value; not exchangeable; while stocks last. Promotion may be amended if operationally necessary.
Your Data
We collect your details to send marketing updates from Royal Plaza on Scotts and Gourmet Carousel, manage your coffee redemption, prevent duplicate claims, and evaluate this campaign. You may withdraw your marketing consent at any time.

title: Carousel Moon Pastries
description:
Meet Carousel Moon Pastries.
This Mid-Autumn, Gourmet Carousel reimagines the traditional mooncake with a touch of contemporary creativity. Handcrafted in Carousel's Halal-certified kitchen in Singapore, our Moon Pastries collection brings together familiar Asian flavours, refined craftsmanship and elegant presentation in every bite.
Discover six distinctive creations:
Emerald Dreams 翡翠之梦 - Pandan pastry with smooth red bean filling
Straits Fusion 南洋月语 - Gula melaka lotus paste with soft mochi
Ondeh Pop 椰香青语 - Pandan coconut filling with cocoa crumbs
Ong Lai Lai 旺萊来 - Sarawak honey pineapple with gold leaf topping
Lotus Blossom 莲韵花香 - Rose lotus paste wrapped in rose-infused pastry
Teochew Treasures 潮州之宝 - Yam paste with pandan and gula melaka
Presented in our signature Weavers Basket, this elegant keepsake is designed for gifting, sharing and creating meaningful Mid-Autumn moments with loved ones.
🚚 Islandwide delivery available
📍 Self-collection at Royal Plaza on Scotts
💰 $88 nett per box
📅 Pre-orders now open, collection from 20 August 2026
